description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Sitinamaluwa, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad Map No. 830117
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details) in various villages and divisions. The content focuses on land ownership, title determinations, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
